header.name: Create distribution groups and processes
header.description: Used on the Work Order Management to create  distribuitons for Work Order Processes and by pass scheduling.

data.query:
query Query($workorderId: String!) {
  workOrder(where: {id: {_eq: $workorderId}}) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        priority
        originalQuantity
        quantity
        integrated
        description
        externalId
        actualFinishAt
        actualStartAt
        earliestStartAt
        promiseAt
        scheduledFinishAt
        scheduledStartAt
        transactionAt
        customData
        integrationData
        workOrderStatusId
        workOrderTypeId
        facilityId
        kanbanRackId
        maintenanceChecklistId
        outsourcePurchaseOrderId
        outsourceSalesOrderId
        outsourceTransferOrderId
        productId
        productStrategyId
        workOrderCategoryId
        workOrderGroupId
        workOrderPriorityId
        workOrderProcesses {
          edges {
            node {
              id
              code
              standardPositions
              standardWorkcenters
              cycleTime
              distributionPercentage
              idealRate
              leadTime
              minimumProductionRunTime
              originalQuantity
              percentToStart
              productionOffalAllowed
              productionOperators
              quantity
              quantityToStart
              quotedRate
              setupOffalAllowed
              setupOperators
              setupRate
              standardRate
              timeToStart
              transitTimeAfter
              transitTimeBefore
              unitPerCycle
              unitWeight
              active
              allowMixedLots
              autoTriggerDependency
              defaultDistribution
              final
              finishedGood
              generatePurchaseOrder
              maintenance
              optional
              rawMaterial
              requireReceipt
              transferSerial
              useSupplierLabel
              useWorkcenterRates
              wip
              description
              externalId
              note
              order
              customData
              integrationData
              processId
              workOrderId
              workOrderProcessStatusId
              controlPanelId
              documentDesignId
              lotControlId
              outsourcePurchaseOrderId
              outsourceTransferOrderId
              productStrategyId
              productStrategyProcessId
              productionTypeId
              putAwayLocationId
              weightUnitId
              workcenterId
              productStrategyProcess {
                coproductBoms: assemblyBoms(where: {bomTypeId: {_eq: "CoProduct"}, active: {_eq: true}}) {
                  edges {
                    node {
                      id
                      componentProduct {
                        id
                        name
                      }
                      componentProductStrategyId
                      assemblyProductStrategyProcessId
                      componentProductStrategyProcess {
                        id
                        unitPerCycle
                        process {
                          code
                        }
                      }
                      order
                      active
                      unitPerCycle
                      useOnWorkOrder
                      buildWorkOrder
                      standardUsage
                      minimumUsage
                      maximumUsage
                      bomTypeId
                      fixedLaborUsage
                      fixedMachineUsage
                      fixedMaterialUsage
                      laborUsage
                      machineUsage
                      consumptionModeId
                      externalId
                      reference
                    }
                  }
                }
                byproductBoms: assemblyBoms(where: {bomTypeId: {_eq: "ByProduct"}, active: {_eq: true}}) {
                  edges {
                    node {
                      id
                      componentProduct {
                        id
                        name
                      }
                      componentProductStrategyId
                      assemblyProductStrategyProcessId
                      componentProductStrategyProcess {
                        id
                        unitPerCycle
                        process {
                          code
                        }
                      }
                      unitPerCycle
                      order
                      active
                      useOnWorkOrder
                      standardUsage
                      minimumUsage
                      maximumUsage
                      bomTypeId
                      fixedLaborUsage
                      fixedMachineUsage
                      fixedMaterialUsage
                      laborUsage
                      machineUsage
                      consumptionModeId
                      externalId
                      reference
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
